description: bigville R44 (block 337000): THEFT AS A MEANINGFUL ACTION AND LAW -- wiring ownership (336000) into the recognition + court machinery. TAKING is a WORLD-FACT (th_take): anyone can physically take what another holds; the substrate never forbids it. THEFT is a RECOGNIZED FRAME, not a fact: each witness who recognizes the owner's claim COLLAPSES {theft,innocent} valued by lawfulness - alliance_to_taker (th_recognize_theft -- the WIRE to the recognition faculty; the lawful see theft, the thief's allies do not, agents DIVERGE); recognized theft = Count(sees_theft) (th_standing). A taking of property NOBODY recognizes is seen by no witness -> standing 0 -> NOT a crime (the frame boundary). A recognized theft (standing >= court.quorum) is a chargeable Offense (th_charge); a panel of jurors COLLAPSES guilt (th_vote/th_cast_guilty), the verdict is the majority (th_verdict); a guilty verdict is ENACTED as restitution -- possession returns to the recognized owner (th_restitution). Taking one's OWN recognized property, or with the owner's CONSENT, is never theft. Custodial sentencing composes with bigville_jail/sentence. Ownership stays recognition (own_recognition, Count) -- owner is never a world fact. v1.1.0: OWNERSHIP RECOGNITION NOW EMERGES from a collapse (own_decide/own_grant): each resident decides {recognize,reject} a claim valued by legitimacy*deference - prop_skepticism -- a legitimate claim gathers broad recognition, a usurper's grab little; ownership is emergent, not seeded, and theft rests on it. And a guilty verdict now imposes DAMAGES (to victim) + a FINE (to court) beyond return-of-goods (th_penalty), coin-CONSERVED and bounded by ability to pay (unpaid remainder = debt). v1.2.0: DEBT COLLECTION IS THE CONSTABLE'S JOB (not an automatic effect). th_penalty now splits the unpaid remainder into debt_damages (owed the victim) + debt_fine (owed the court). con_office: the constable's authority = Count(recognizers) (recognized office, not a title). con_duty: the constable COLLAPSES {enforce, forbear} valued by duty - how he FEELS about THIS debtor, read from his first-class held Bond(A->B) TOWARD the charged party (warmth = affect_affection - affect_resentment, the SAME quantity bigville_fast_bond reads; the Bond's six relational emotions are evolved by bigville_bond_update -- NOT a loyalty knob). th_collect: a RECOGNIZED, enforcing constable collects the debt -- damages-first then fine, capped at the debtor's coin, repeating as they earn until cleared; lawful because the office AND the judgment are recognized. A loyal constable forbears; an unrecognized 'constable' cannot lawfully collect. v1.3.0 (block 354000, design-audit 6.1/6.4 Step B): COMPOSES bigville_recognition -- depends_on it, and the ownership-recognition COUNT is now the canonical rc_count (parameterised over the claim node) living in bigville_recognition; theft's duplicate own_recognition is DELETED. The adapter loads bigville_recognition before bigville_theft, so rc_count fires on each recognized OwnershipClaim (per-claim by the match-bound join, the 6.7 measurement). The ownership COLLAPSE (own_decide/own_grant, lean = legitimacy*deference - prop_skepticism) stays theft's own: its lean is ownership-specific and differs from rc_recognize's (fear*force + opportunism - loyalty), so routing it through the canonical collapse is 6.2 (shared stance codebook, deferred) not 6.1. Ownership claims are still seeded with recognition=0.0 so a claim NOBODY recognizes reads 0 (rc_count fires only where a recognizes edge exists). v1.4.0 (block 355000, design-audit 6.3/6.4 Step C + 6.10): COMPOSES bigville_court -- the VERDICT is now the court's collapse, not theft's own jury. th_vote/th_cast_guilty/th_verdict are DELETED. th_charge mints a court Charge/Matter (adds off -about_subject-> taker and town -has_charge-> off; weight = item.theft_standing, threshold = Count(on_council)*0.5+0.5 = a strict majority, penalty/standing_penalty 0 so ct_sentence is an economic no-op). th_refer seats each juror's consideration (juror -considers-> off) so agent_judgment's jc_conclude fires per juror; bigville_court's ct_hear/ct_condemn/ct_verdict_guilty/ct_verdict_acquit aggregate the collapse. The juror's theft lean (lawfulness*theft_standing - doubt) is reproduced through jc_conclude's lean (weight*credence + punitiveness - deference*standing) by the adapter mapping credence=lawfulness, punitiveness=-doubt (the defendant's standing is 0 so the deference term vanishes). th_restitution/th_penalty now read off.status=='guilty' (the court's verdict), not the deleted off.decided/off.guilty. FINE SINK RECONCILED (6.10): th_penalty's fine and th_collect's fine now flow to the town Treasury (tr.collected), the SAME coffer bigville_court's ct_sentence fines -- not court.coin. v1.5.0 (block 356000, design-audit 6.4 Step D + 6.10): COMPOSES bigville_bond_update -- the constable's Bond is no longer an adapter-seeded STATIC feeling; its six relational emotions EVOLVE from a benefit/betrayal HISTORY. The adapter seeds the Bond with the bond-dynamics knobs (update_gain>0, pos_weight, neg_weight, reappraise_factor) and attaches BondEvent nodes (bond -has_event-> ev); bond_event_benefit raises affect_affection from a positive event (the debtor once helped the constable), bond_event_betrayal raises affect_resentment (and re-appraises affection down) from a negative one. con_duty reads the EVOLVED warmth = affect_affection - affect_resentment -- a constable forbears for someone whose kindness EARNED his warmth, enforces on one who betrayed him. Falsifier: update_gain=0 freezes the bond to its 0 prior, so no history moves the feeling and the fond constable no longer forbears. v1.6.0 (block 357000, design-audit 6.4 Step E): ADAPTER SHRINK -- the collapse stance codebooks (TheftStance/OwnStance/DutyStance + the graded judgment Stance the court's jurors collapse over) are now SEED DATA in this manifest's `nodes` (installed by the loader), not minted in the adapter. The adapter builds only the per-scenario world (town/court/treasury + agents/items/OwnershipClaims/Bonds -- legitimate world ingest), arms th_take, and reads. (has_juror minting was retired in Step C when jurors were seated on the court's on_council panel; the static Bond scalar was retired in Step D when the constable's feeling became an evolved benefit/betrayal history.)

rules.name: own_decide
rules.comment: OWNERSHIP RECOGNITION IS A DECISION (the wire): each alive resident collapses {recognize, reject} an OwnershipClaim, valued by claim.legitimacy*deference - prop_skepticism (Argmax over OwnStance, same shape as rc_recognize). A LEGITIMATE claim (provenance) gathers broad recognition from the law-abiding; a usurper's low-legitimacy grab gathers little -- ownership EMERGES, it is not seeded. Fires only on claims with legitimacy > 0 (a bare 0-legitimacy claim recognizes no one).

rules.name: own_grant
rules.comment: A resident whose collapse chose 'recognize' grants ownership recognition. Once per (r,claim).

rules.name: th_take
rules.comment: WORLD-FACT: an armed taker physically takes an item the holder holds -- possession transfers. The substrate does NOT forbid it (like rc_strike). Marks the taking so the town can RECOGNIZE it as theft, or not.

rules.name: th_recognize_theft
rules.comment: THEFT IS RECOGNIZED, not a fact (the WIRE to the recognition faculty). Each alive witness who RECOGNIZES the owner's claim collapses {theft, innocent} valued by lawfulness - alliance_to_taker: the lawful see theft, the thief's allies do not -- agents DIVERGE. Fires only when the taker is NOT the recognized owner and there was no consent. Property nobody recognizes is seen by no witness -> no crime.

rules.name: th_grant_theft
rules.comment: A witness whose collapse chose 'theft' backs it -- sees_theft edge. Once per (w,item).

rules.name: th_standing
rules.comment: Recognized theft = Count(sees_theft). Unrecognized property -> 0 -> no crime.

rules.name: th_charge
rules.comment: A taking the town RECOGNIZES as theft (standing >= court.quorum) becomes a chargeable Offense (offender, victim=owner, over the item). A taking nobody recognizes as theft (standing < quorum) is NOT charged -- no crime.

rules.name: th_refer
rules.comment: COMPOSE THE COURT (design-audit 6.3, block 355000): each seated juror (on_council) CONSIDERS the charge, so agent_judgment's jc_conclude fires per juror -- the verdict is the court's collapse, not theft's own th_vote. Once per (juror, charge).

rules.name: th_restitution
rules.comment: A GUILTY theft verdict is enacted: possession RETURNS to the recognized owner (world-fact reversal). Custodial sentencing composes with bigville_jail/sentence.

rules.name: th_penalty
rules.comment: A GUILTY theft verdict imposes DAMAGES (item value, to victim) + a FINE (value*fine_rate, to court) on top of restitution. Coin-CONSERVED: pay damages-first then fine, capped at the offender's balance; the UNPAID remainder is split into debt_damages (still owed the victim) + debt_fine (still owed the court) for the constable to collect. Offender coin written LAST.

rules.name: con_office
rules.comment: The constable's authority = Count(residents who recognize the office). Not a title.

rules.name: con_duty
rules.comment: The constable collapses {enforce, forbear} valued by duty - how he FEELS about THIS debtor, read from his first-class held Bond TOWARD the charged party (con -holds_bond-> bond -toward-> debtor): warmth = affect_affection - affect_resentment, the SAME quantity bigville_fast_bond reads. He forbears for someone he feels warmly toward (a brother, a friend) beyond his duty; he enforces on someone he feels nothing/ill for. The feeling is the real directed Bond(A->B) with its six relational emotions -- evolved by bigville_bond_update (benefit/betrayal/gossip), NOT a loyalty knob. No Bond toward the debtor -> no warmth read -> duty alone.

rules.name: th_collect
rules.comment: THE CONSTABLE'S JOB: a constable whose office the town RECOGNIZES (authority >= quorum) and who chose to ENFORCE collects the offender's outstanding debt -- victim's damages FIRST, then the court's fine -- capped at what the debtor now HOLDS, repeating as the debtor earns until cleared. A world-fact transfer made LAWFUL by the recognized office + recognized judgment. NB effect ORDER: the collected amounts are stored on the offense FIRST (take_dmg/take_fine), then every transfer reads those STABLE values -- otherwise the take terms would re-read debt_damages after it is mutated (the C6 sequential-effects gotcha).
